title: MOVE_VERTEX payload
description: Move a vertex to a target point by solving the planes of the incident faces marked movable (v0.3 §6 F-25; spec §10.4).

movableFaceIds.description: Faces whose support planes may change; every other plane is fixed (spec §5 rule 7, §10.1 rule 3).

$comment: [P] Field names. An empty movableFaceIds is allowed (spec §10.4 rule 4).
